text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Hyperplasia with Atypia. The combination of postmenopausal bleeding, a thickened endometrial stripe, and an adnexal mass in a 65-year-old woman strongly suggests this condition, possibly with concurrent ovarian pathology, though the primary life-threatening concern is the endometrial finding.
